content.text:
stages:
  - test
  - oci-image
  - attestation

include:
  - remote: "https://gitlab.opencode.de/l3montree/devguard-ci-components/-/raw/v1.12.1/templates/full.yml"
    inputs:
      devguard_asset_name: "$DEVGUARD_ASSET_NAME"
      devguard_token: "$DEVGUARD_TOKEN"
      devguard_api_url: "$DEVGUARD_API_URL"
      devguard_web_ui: "https://devguard.opencode.de"
=== DockerfileApp ===
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1@sha256:ecfaec9ed6d810b56388c508f4121597bfbba70d41a6dfeee4d8cad5f295fc32
# check=error=true

ARG BASE_IMAGE_TAG=base
FROM registry.cowain.dev/lvsn/openculturas-distribution:${BASE_IMAGE_TAG}
ARG APP_ENV
ENV APP_ENV=${APP_ENV:-UNKNOWN}

WORKDIR /app/code

COPY ./composer.json /app/code/composer.json
COPY ./composer.lock /app/code/composer.lock
COPY ./scripts/ /app/code/scripts
COPY ./config/ /app/code/config
COPY ./vendor/ /app/code/vendor
COPY ./web/ /app/code/web
COPY ./profile/ /app/code/profile
COPY ./.gitlab/cloudron.settings.php /app/code/web/sites/default/settings.php

RUN ln -sf /app/data/files /app/code/web/sites/default/files

observation.command: cd /workspace; cat .gitlab/opencode-ci.yml; echo "=== DockerfileApp ==="; cat .gitlab/DockerfileApp 2>/dev/null | head -60
